findings: CVE-2025-68480 remains PUBLISHED on cveawg.mitre.org; GHSA-428g-f7cq-pgp5 is not withdrawn; vendor patched 3.26.2 and 4.1.2. This is a real vulnerability, not FALSE_POSITIVE.
Quadratic amplification is specifically indexed many=True error accumulation: wrapping {index: messages} and merge_errors copying the entire self.errors dict on every invalid item.

BIC 8a6ad548df6b9cac377e748551248bde6df5619c is the first commit that routes each indexed failure through merge_errors(self.errors, ...); parent dddaf8edf8dffb0453ac7fb06113f9636985ba90 still updates only the per-index sub-dictionary.
b2e5a7da74d2f62a4d3694a43bc31248eb14be24 and 9a83efdc67b5f694e37d371397b314e6e3fa4dcd are necessary precursors but do not yet copy all prior indices per item.
